def parse_csv_line(line):
    fields = []
    current = []
    in_quotes = False
    index = 0
    while index < len(line):
        ch = line[index]
        if ch == '"' and (index == 0 or line[index - 1] != '"'):
            in_quotes = not in_quotes
        elif ch == '"' and index > 0 and line[index - 1] == '"':
            current.append('"')
        elif ch == ',' and not in_quotes:
            fields.append(''.join(current))
            current = []
        else:
            current.append(ch)
        index += 1
    fields.append(''.join(current))
    return fields
